reviewedInvariants.invariant: Atomic selection refusal before session lookup, requests or product writes
reviewedInvariants.assessment: selectDatasetRoots runs before localDatasetSession and catalogue epoch discovery. A refused result writes only its local diagnostic manifest, then throws. No partial selection reaches the transport.

reviewedInvariants.invariant: Accepted selection consumes its entire closure without a second record cap
reviewedInvariants.assessment: The accepted view supplies sources/records/edges/images. A present selection bypasses the legacy maxRecords slice, including maxRecords=0. The parent remains the source of record identity, inventory and original occurrence indices.

Context includes origin, actor, product dataEpoch, parent snapshot id/digest and optional selection digest. Existing journal headers are checked; parent source references preserve record digest and ordered intake digests. Distinct selection views do not replace the parent. Product/actor identity lock serializes cross-snapshot reuse alongside the legacy exact-context lock.

reviewedInvariants.invariant: Native identity reuse and both retained 113-identity epochs
reviewedInvariants.assessment: Only journals for the same API origin/actor/dataEpoch contribute identities. Conflicts refuse; unresolved previous native intents require resuming that snapshot before creation. Durable bulk child receipts recover after a crash. The 113-row fixture tests each of its two identity columns independently, excludes the other epoch, preserves old journal bytes and expects no creation or new mapped facts. This is not a live census of the original four current receipts or three historical receipts.

reviewedInvariants.invariant: Replay and CAS retain acknowledged intent and independent edits
reviewedInvariants.assessment: Command replay uses saved method/path/body/result. Mapper revision participates in the command label; fresh reads bypass the command journal. A stale uncommitted CAS is not silently rebased. Cover commands are rechecked for current owner fences, while previous responses remain in history. New cover selection refuses an existing image choice; an old selection intent is replayed verbatim.

reviewedInvariants.invariant: Acquisition/source digests remain exact and distinct
reviewedInvariants.assessment: Retained intake receipt byteDigest must equal SHA256 of the exact submitted part. Frozen image blobs are hash-verified and checked against capture length/type/URL; source record digest, original capture digest, importer evidence-observation digest and uploaded image digest keep distinct meanings. No new capture is substituted.

reviewedInvariants.invariant: Producer plans cannot certify native adoption
reviewedInvariants.assessment: Field plans remain candidates without exact retained conversion/adoption support. Only previously acknowledged native projection values matching the current source are marked acknowledged-native-value; this is historical value correspondence, not Source support or a fresh native read. Unchanged source identity alone cannot claim adoption of a changed title. Default fields mapper is absent and remains pending.

reviewedInvariants.invariant: Alias and language evidence remains qualified
reviewedInvariants.assessment: Field plans validate exact source identity/digest. Alias evidence retains paths, raw values, digest and occurrence ordinal; explicit locale is retained. Language canonicalization is a projection and does not rewrite the frozen spelling. UI locale does not supply an alias language. Invalid/missing qualification stays pending/source evidence.

reviewedInvariants.invariant: Elected validated Work cover and frozen indices
reviewedInvariants.assessment: datasetWorkCoverImages validates/repairs a clone and elects only a supported Work cover. frozenCoverOccurrences matches immutable descriptor/capture/evidence content back to original occurrence queues, including evidence-free originals repaired in the clone. A failed repair cannot fall back to admitting raw evidence. Only the elected original occurrence can enter public source/media/selection commands; other cover candidates remain source-only.

reviewedInvariants.invariant: Coverage distinguishes absent, unacquired, source-only and mapped
reviewedInvariants.assessment: All parent source fields and original edges/images are inventoried; zero/false remain observed. Never-acquired candidates have /sources/<s>/images/<i> keys and not-acquired state, without invented /images indices. Mapping requires retained source, target, native read path and receipt, cannot map unavailable acquisition or downgrade/change an acknowledged target. Subordinate pending plans cannot erase mapped cover facts.

reviewedInvariants.invariant: Transport completion does not imply native completeness
reviewedInvariants.assessment: journal.completed describes selected transport traversal. catalogueReady additionally requires all mapper phases, no unmapped inventory, native facts for parent roots and no pending selected acquisitions. Parent-wide entries remain visible outside a selected view, making readiness conservative. Offline conformance checks inventory/digest/disposition consistency, not independent native receipt authenticity.
